name: fedifeeds_key
comment: The wiki's own key pair, generated the first time it is needed

columns.name: fk_name
columns.comment: Which key; only main so far

columns.name: fk_private_key
columns.comment: The private key as PEM

columns.name: fk_timestamp
columns.comment: When the key was generated

name: fedifeeds_follower
comment: Remote actors that follow a feed

columns.name: ff_feed
columns.comment: Handle of the feed, such as category_4521

columns.name: ff_actor
columns.comment: Id of the remote actor

columns.name: ff_inbox
columns.comment: Where to deliver: the actor's shared inbox, or else its inbox

columns.name: ff_timestamp
columns.comment: When the follow was accepted

name: fedifeeds_item
comment: Items of a feed as they appeared. Only items recorded here were sent, so only they get Update or Delete

columns.name: fi_feed
columns.comment: Handle of the feed, such as category_4521

columns.name: fi_page
columns.comment: Page id of the item

columns.name: fi_key
columns.comment: What tells the item apart within the page: for a section item the texts of its heading and the headings above it, one per line, or their SHA-256 when that is longer than the column; empty for a category item, which is the page itself

columns.name: fi_rev
columns.comment: The revision the item appeared in, or 0 for an item recorded before this was

columns.name: fi_anchor
columns.comment: The anchor of a section item's heading in fi_rev, as it goes in a link; empty for a category item

columns.name: fi_timestamp
columns.comment: When the item appeared

name: fedifeeds_quote
comment: Quotes of notes that were authorized, each served as a QuoteAuthorization until the quote is withdrawn

columns.name: fq_feed
columns.comment: Handle of the feed whose note is quoted, such as category_4521

columns.name: fq_item
columns.comment: The quoted item, as the last part of its note id: a page id, or the encoded key of a section item

columns.name: fq_actor
columns.comment: Id of the remote actor that quotes

columns.name: fq_post
columns.comment: Id of the remote post that quotes

columns.name: fq_request
columns.comment: Id of the QuoteRequest, which an Undo names

columns.name: fq_timestamp
columns.comment: When the quote was authorized

name: fedifeeds_reaction
comment: Likes and Announces of the notes of a feed's items, one per remote actor, item and kind

columns.name: fr_feed
columns.comment: Handle of the feed, such as category_4521

columns.name: fr_page
columns.comment: Page id of the item

columns.name: fr_key
columns.comment: The item's key, as fi_key: empty for a category item

columns.name: fr_type
columns.comment: like, for a Like or an emoji reaction, or announce, for an Announce

columns.name: fr_actor
columns.comment: Id of the remote actor, so that each actor counts once and its Undo or Delete finds its rows

columns.name: fr_activity
columns.comment: Id of the Like or Announce, which an Undo may name it by; empty when it had none that fits

columns.name: fr_timestamp
columns.comment: When the reaction was received
